pr_title: [wasi][Windows] SingleFilebundle project with long path results in linking error
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/106845.

- Add possibility to place wasi build tests in a customable parent dir
- Add test with long path to directory. It fails only on Windows, with `WasmSingleFileBundle = true`.

The error is connected with [command line string limitation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-client/shell-experience/command-line-string-limitation), where the whole `clang-link.rsp` file is treated as a part of the command. Linking response file includes ~200 linked objects, out of which ~180 is in the project's path. From this reason, each char leading to the project elongates the .rsp file by ~180 chars. Possible solutions:
- use relative paths
- link in batches.

Using relative paths helped, thanks @lewing. Pasting the original log with failure before fix was applied, [CI failure](https://helixre107v0xdcypoyl9e7f.blob.core.windows.net/dotnet-runtime-refs-pull-107253-merge-813104408c82480796/Workloads-ST-Wasm.Build.Tests/1/console.f5a83340.log?helixlogtype=result):
